sources.note: Main website. Describes Healthie as HIPAA-compliant EHR/practice management for 40,000+ providers. Lists core features: charting, scheduling, billing, telehealth, messaging, patient portal, AI scribe, journaling.
ONC mandatory disclosures page. Confirms certification date 2022-12-07, describes product as comprehensive web and mobile platform, mentions monthly fee pricing model.

Platform overview page detailing practice management (scheduling, billing, insurance, reporting), EHR (intake, charting, care plans, e-labs, e-rx, AI scribe), and patient engagement (portal, telehealth, messaging, programs, journaling).

Detailed EHR features page. Describes customizable charting notes, multiple templates, vitals trend dashboard, patient groups/tagging, e-rx with EPCS, e-lab integrations, medication documentation, allergy reconciliation, PDMP access, care plan templates.

Pricing page with four tiers: Core ($19/mo), Essentials ($49/mo), Plus ($129/mo), Group ($149+/mo). Shows which features are gated by plan level — e.g., superbills at Essentials+, ClaimMD at Plus+, team features at Group.
Case studies page listing customers across behavioral health, nutrition, women's health, chronic conditions, wellness programs, non-profits, and digital health startups.
Series B announcement. $23M raised (total $42M). Reports 25,000+ active providers, 10M+ patient records, 10M+ appointments, 1B+ API calls/month. Describes serving 'underdogs of healthcare.'

Detailed billing documentation. Covers superbills, CMS 1500, ClaimMD and Office Ally integrations, eligibility checks, ERA processing, support for fee-for-service, value-based care, and concierge models.
E-Labs help article confirming lab ordering integrations with Rupa Health, Evexia, and Fullscript.
E-Rx help article confirming DoseSpot integration for electronic prescribing.
EPCS documentation confirming controlled substance prescribing via DoseSpot add-on at $20/month on Enterprise plan.
Food journaling feature documentation. Photo-based meal logging, nutrient tracking via Edamam database (900K+ foods), hunger levels, mood tracking, reflections.
Nutrient tracking documentation. Confirms Edamam integration for detailed nutritional analysis.
Journal entries documentation covering food, activity, metrics, and selfie logging. Wearable sync with Fitbit, Google Fit, Apple Health.
Fullscript integration for supplement recommendations, ordering, and tracking within Healthie.
The Harbor marketplace documentation. Describes built-in vs. partner integrations, two integration types.
The Harbor integration marketplace listing partner apps and integrations.
Third-party review (403 on fetch but search snippet confirmed). Describes Healthie as suited for therapists and wellness providers, notes pros/cons, pricing from $49/month.
Capterra reviews (403 on fetch). Search results show 86% user satisfaction rating from 59 reviews. Praised for client management, scheduling, telehealth, billing integration, and customer support.
Software Advice profile for Healthie with reviews and pricing information.
PR Newswire Series B announcement confirming $23M raise, TCV lead, $42M total funding.
GraphQL API documentation portal. Confirms API-first architecture with full platform access.
